rationale: ADMA gapped up ~14.6% on earnings beat news from over 20 hours ago and has been consolidating in a tight range near $13.21-13.25 for the last several minutes, sitting 70.9% through today's range with the 9-EMA at $13.27 acting as mild resistance overhead. The broader market is under severe stress (SPY -3.85%, VIXY +22.19%), which creates conflicting pressure — the stock has shown relative strength today but with 53 minutes to close and a gap-up name in a risk-off tape, the directional edge is unclear and the risk/reward for either a long chase near the high or a short against demonstrated relative strength is insufficient to justify a new position.
